answer: Dormant-activation identity: a new identity starts dormant and must pass three unannounced liveness re-checks within thirty days, each a challenge signed with its bound identity key, to earn standing. Missing one check resets the clock, and lockstep answers flag a batch. A Sybil farmer cannot mint a haven of puppets on a terrace of cheap accounts and walk away: each puppet needs a month of responsive attention, and automation answering for the whole flock exposes it at once. Each quill-signed check proves a live operator behind one identity, so bulk forgery becomes bulk sustained labor.
